oriel-2.text: Light them and the Spire barrier falls.
oriel-2.speaker: oriel

oriel-3.text: Touch a waystone to travel back here.
oriel-3.speaker: oriel

tallow-wake.text: There you are. Up you get.
tallow-wake.speaker: tallow

tallow-gate.text: Light the brazier at the gate.
tallow-gate.speaker: tallow

tallow-vista.text: Look. The Glade Beacon. Let's light it.
tallow-vista.speaker: tallow

tallow-ride.text: Jump onto the line. I'll hold you.
tallow-ride.speaker: tallow

tallow-mem0.text: I was bigger once. I lit ships home.
tallow-mem0.speaker: tallow

tallow-mem2.text: The water rose. They chose the lamp over the boat.
tallow-mem2.speaker: tallow

tallow-mem3.text: Their name was... I gave it to the dark.
tallow-mem3.speaker: tallow
